headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty fell for a fourth session as surging oil prices triggered weekly losses.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Surging global crude oil prices nearing $114 per barrel due to West Asia tensions
Small and midcap indices posting their worst weekly decline in two years
Widening losses in the quick-commerce sector impacting investor confidence
A significant drop in India's net FDI inflows to $3 billion in August
whatHappening: The Nifty ended the week at 22,600 while the Sensex shed 1,600 points over five sessions
Jio IPO received a blockbuster response with Rs 7.4 lakh crore in bids and 22x subscription
IndusInd Bank reported a net profit of Rs 1,242 crore supported by lower provisions
BSE has initiated the search for a successor to its MD and CEO ahead of a 2027 exit
summary: The Indian market ended the last session lower, extending its losing streak to four days as crude oil prices surged above $114. Small and midcap indices faced their worst weekly decline in two years, with the Sensex shedding 1,600 points across the week. Despite the broader sell-off, the Jio IPO saw record-breaking demand and IndusInd Bank reported steady quarterly profits.
